title: Measure the idle macOS runner minutes that docs-only PRs spend, over 2 weeks
why: Lane notes-fix-merge-ci, 14:38 CST: checks-macos-b starts an idle macOS runner on docs-only PRs. Decision ci-job-caps says that cost is unmeasured. Skipping the job with a job-level if would break the all-jobs-passed rollup, which fails a skipped job.
note: Measure first, then ask: count docs-only PR runs and their idle macOS minutes over 2 weeks, from GitHub's run data. Then file a page question with the numbers: let the rollup accept a skipped scoped job (a widening of a shared check, never the pick), or keep as is. Taken without a page question, because a measure can be undone and needs no owner word (parallelism-keep-going). Note checks-macos-b-idle-runner keeps `Fix: none` until then. Cost: GitHub API reads, once.
